title: AAPS 3.3.0-dev-b: Administering carbs and bolus from watch tile are ignored by AAPS
body:
**AndroidAPS 3.3.0-dev-b**
Build: 5b13a68d4d7076fdf695cd5115617f30ce982432
Watchface: same build, *AAPS Watchface: Custom Watchface*
Flavor: Fullrelease

**Problem description:**
Sinds latest dev build carbs entered from watch through the AAPS watchface tiles are only registered once after (re)starting AAPS. Any subsequent carbs are ignored by AAPS (not added to COB, not listed in treatments)

**Repro:**
See screenshots of AAPS treatments:
- AAPS restarted through ... menu:
At 22:05h carbs where administered from the tile for the amounts of 1,2 and 3 grams of carbs from the watch.

- AAPS restarted through ... menu:
At 22:07h carbs where administered from the tile for the amounts of 11,12,13 and 14 grams of carbs from the watch.

Note that only the entries for 1 and 11 grams (first actions after restarting AAPS) are registered. Any subsequent carbs entered from the watch are ignored by AAPS. Standard confirmations on watch, no errors on watch or in AAPS

**Screenshots**
![tile](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/45144129/87d56465-215b-4599-a2d4-40c47a796ba7)

![Treatments](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/45144129/d2d9127f-df0a-47a3-af79-3f8b7b9ab027)

**logs & screenshots**
